title: Fear Uber Widow Maker!
description: Fear Uber Widow Maker! — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ex-Soldier Bubba

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 35 Bone Collectors and 35 Ember Devastators in Widower's Nest

Quest Reward: 3125 Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 35 Toxic Raythes and 35 Toxic Haunts in the Upper One Offs and in Lower Widower's Nest and Report to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of Widower's Nest.

Offer:

So, it looks like the Fire Fade aren't the only ones involved in this operation. The Bone Collectors and Devastators that you were fighting were sent to contact the Demon Spawn, although we aren't sure why, but we believe that they are part of an effort to resurrect the Widower to her former glory.

You see, back when the Widower's Nest was a brand new dungeon it was the hardest and most challenging dungeon of the day. That was back when you could fit everything you ever needed into a 6x4 inventory! Now that we got this used copy of the Widower's Nest, we think the Fades there will do anything within their power to resurrect the old Widow Maker, which would result in a 900% increase in deaths by Dungeon Runners there and I don't need to tell you that those numbers will be unacceptable to the King's Board of Trustees.

Find these Poison Demon Spawn, these Toxic Raythes and Haunts, and send them back to the depths from which they were spawned. We may have an idea of what is happening, but we must be sure. Return to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest when you have carried out this deed and maybe he will have some answers for you by that time.

Turn-in:

Fantastic job out there! We have made a breakthrough, let me tell you what we have learned.

Objectives:

  • Slain Toxic Raythe
  • Slain Toxic Haunt

Level range: 25–40
